title: 绝句（迟日江山丽）
author: 杜甫
intro: Four lines, four pictures of a spring day: sunlit hills, a fragrant breeze, swallows building nests, ducks dozing on warm sand. A gentle, easy poem from a poet usually known for sorrow.
analysis: 这是一首描写春天的小诗，每一句都是一幅画。第一句写大景：春天白天变长了，阳光照着江和山，非常明丽。第二句写感觉：春风吹来，带着花草的香味——不只是看，还能闻到。第三句写动的：泥土化开变软了，燕子飞来飞去，衔泥做窝。第四句写静的：沙滩被太阳晒暖了，一对对鸳鸯在上面睡觉。一动一静，一远一近，春天的温暖、明亮、热闹都写出来了。杜甫一生经历很多苦难，这首诗是他在成都过上一段安定日子时写的，所以特别轻松愉快。诗里的字都很简单，很适合初学者背诵。
analysisEn: Each line of this little spring poem is a picture of its own. The first is the wide view: the days are getting longer, and the river and hills are bright in the sun. The second brings in another sense — the spring breeze carries the smell of flowers and grass. The third line has movement: the earth has thawed into soft mud, and swallows dart about, carrying it off to build their nests. The fourth is stillness: on sand warmed by the sun, pairs of mandarin ducks are asleep. Far and near, moving and still, the four lines together give the whole feel of a warm, bright spring day. Du Fu lived through war, poverty and exile, and most of his famous poems are heavy. This one was written during a rare peaceful stretch in Chengdu, and it shows — it is relaxed and happy. The vocabulary is very simple, which makes it a good poem for beginners to learn by heart.
background: Du Fu (712–770) wrote this around 764, while living in his thatched cottage outside Chengdu, Sichuan, one of the calmest periods of his life. He wrote many poems simply titled “Quatrain”; this one is known by its first line.
pronunciation: 燕子 yàn zi（“子”读轻声）；鸳鸯 yuān yāng。
version: 采用通行教材版本（杜甫《绝句二首》其一），无重要异文。

lines.lit: Long spring days: river and hills are lovely;
lines.en: The spring days lengthen; river and hills shine bright,

lines.lit: the spring wind, flowers and grass fragrant.
lines.en: the spring breeze smells of flowers and grass.
The mud has softened, and swallows swoop;
on the warm sand, mandarin ducks doze.

words.note: 一种四句的诗体，五言绝句每句五个字。
“迟”这里是“慢、长”：春天白天变长，太阳落得晚。现代汉语“迟”多指“晚”，如“迟到”。
这里指风景；现代汉语“江山”也常指国家政权。
现代汉语也说。燕子春天飞回来，衔泥做窝。
常成对出现，在中国文化里象征夫妻恩爱；现代汉语也常用。

imagery.name: 春风
imagery.zh: 春风送来花草香，写出春天温暖、生机勃勃的感觉。
imagery.en: The spring breeze carries the scent of flowers and grass — warmth and new life.

imagery.name: 燕
imagery.zh: 燕子衔泥飞来飞去，是春天最热闹、最有生气的画面。
imagery.en: Swallows busily carrying mud for their nests are the liveliest sign of spring.

imagery.name: 花
imagery.zh: 花草的香气让春天不只看得见，也闻得到。
imagery.en: The smell of flowers lets you not only see the spring but breathe it in.
